credits.title: Ice Cream Man
credits.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

credits.title: Festival of the Living Dead
credits.overview: While attending a festival to commemorate the original zombie attack, Ash and her friends encounter the living dead and must fight back or be devoured.

credits.title: Thanksgiving
credits.overview: After a Black Friday riot ends in tragedy, a mysterious Thanksgiving-inspired killer terrorizes Plymouth, Massachusetts - the birthplace of the holiday. Picking off residents one by one, what begins as random revenge killings are soon revealed to be part of a larger, sinister holiday plan.
